messages.author: fe049c2835236bb1
messages.subject: Re: Projection at multiple RPC scenarios
parts:
Dimitris,

You can change the RCP in the "Project to New Time" module and download the projected rasters one by one in the "Project Model" component. Did you want to do something more than simply acquire the projections? If so, that's where the present functionality ends, but you can download the code and write your own further analyses in.

J

messages.author: fe049c2835236bb1
messages.subject: Re: Projection at multiple RPC scenarios
parts:
Ah I think I understand now. Currently, Wallace only projects to future climate data that you can download from WorldClim. This is to avoid all the complications that can arise if the user does not input the correct extent, variable names, etc. for the projected data. We may change this in the future though. For now, download the code at the end of the session after projecting something with Worldclim bioclim variables, and modify the step to include your own rasters. If you need assistance with this, please post the code along with what the directory looks like for your raster data and I can help out.

Jamie
